Instructor’s qualifications and training course outlines shall be reviewed by The Santa Cruz County Sheriff’s Office
Administration Lieutenant for approval. An approved Instructor and training course shall comply with all applicable California
laws and Regulations. Ref CPC 26165 & Cal. Code Regs. Tit. 11 4410
Certificates of completion shall minimally include the name of the applicant, title of course, date of completion, make, model
and serial number of firearms, and name and signature of the instructor.
